p1: In 1966, two men were found dead on a hill in Brazil... with masks made of lead over their eyes.
A young man flying a kite found them, lying side by side.
Two electronics technicians... in suits and raincoats.
Days earlier, at a bar in Niteroi, one of them bought a bottle of water... and kept checking his watch.
Beside the bodies: the empty bottle, towels... and a notebook.
"16:30, be at the agreed place. 18:30, swallow capsules. After effect, protect metals. Wait for mask signal."
No injuries. No sign of a struggle.
The bodies had decayed too much to test for poison. The cause of death was never found.
People close to them said they were into "scientific spiritualism."
What capsules? What signal? Sixty years later... nobody knows.
